text:
Liam: Quick idea  micro-lunch tomorrow 12:15-1pm on 6th floor quiet room. 45-min boardgame blitz + bring-your-own lunch. Fast, low-key. Who's in?
Nora: short and sweet, i'm down. can only stay until 12:50 tho. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Isha: love it. i can bring Tiny Towns (fast 2p-4p).
Carlos: in! i'll grab premade sandwiches. any allergy notes?
Becky: might swing by for the last 20 mins if i'm free. :pray: do we need tables?
Liam: we have 2 fold tables in 6F closet. i'll fetch.
Nora: also maybe a 5-min "intro to rules" so games actually finish.
Isha: yes please. short rule primer works.
Becky: could we do a 1-question snack poll? /poll "Snack preference" "Savory (sandwiches/pretzels)" "Sweet (cookies/bars)" "Fruit/vegan"
events-bot: Poll created: Snack preference. Votes open for 12 hours.
Carlos: voted savory. also FYI i can do a tiny extra batch of gluten-free crackers.
Liam: perfect. backup plan: if more than 8 ppl, split into 2 quick rounds and rotate.
Nora: can we keep it noise-level friendly? some folks are on calls nearby.
Liam: yup, low volume only. headphones for phone calls.
Isha: bringing a small timer so turns are short.
Becky: tagging facilities: can we reserve 6th fl quiet room? @facilities?
events-bot: Room reservation request submitted for 6F Quiet Room. Tentative hold 12:00-1:15.
Carlos: sweet. see y'all tomorrow. :game_die::sandwich: 
Liam: awesome, thanks. i'll post reminder at 11:30 and stick the game list in the thread.
Becky: thanks for organizing! :heart:
